name: Paneer tikka sandwich
method: Mix crumbled paneer, yogurt, spice, onion and pepper.
Microwave in a safe bowl for 2 minutes, stir, then heat in 30-second bursts until hot; or pan-cook 4–5 minutes.
Fill bread and toast in a pan or sandwich press, if available.

name: Cheesy spinach corn sandwich
method: Microwave spinach, corn and milk in a safe bowl for 1–2 minutes.
Drain excess liquid; mix in cheese and pepper.
Fill bread and toast in a pan/press, or microwave briefly until cheese melts.

name: Chutney cheese toastie
method: Spread chutney on bread.
Add cheese and tomato; close sandwich.
Toast in a pan/press until golden, or microwave until cheese melts.

name: Hummus cucumber sandwich
method: Spread hummus on bread.
Layer on cucumber, tomato and pepper.
Close, cut in half and serve.

name: Shortcut aloo paratha
method: Pierce potato with a fork; microwave 4–6 minutes, turning halfway, until soft. Cool, peel and mash.
Mix potato with cumin, chilli and salt. Sandwich between tortillas or fill/seal dough.
Pan-cook with a little oil for 2–3 minutes per side.

name: Paneer bhurji paratha wrap
method: Chop onion and tomato; crumble paneer.
Cook onion in oil for 2 minutes, add tomato for 2 minutes, then paneer and masala for 2–3 minutes.
Warm paratha/tortilla, fill and roll.

name: Cheese corn paratha
method: Microwave frozen corn with a teaspoon of water for 1 minute; drain.
Mix corn, cheese and optional chilli; fill half the paratha and fold.
Pan-cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melty.

name: Creamy spinach pasta
method: Boil pasta according to packet; reserve a little pasta water and drain.
Cook garlic in butter/oil for 30 seconds; add spinach until wilted.
Add milk and cheese over low heat; toss in pasta and loosen with pasta water if needed.

name: Tomato garlic pasta
method: Boil pasta according to packet; reserve a little water and drain.
Cook garlic in oil for 30 seconds; add tomatoes and seasoning, simmer 5–7 minutes.
Toss pasta in sauce; top with cheese if wanted.

name: One-pot masala macaroni
method: Cook chopped onion in a little oil for 2 minutes; add tomato and masala for 1 minute.
Add macaroni, peas, ketchup, salt and water; bring to a boil.
Simmer 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until pasta is tender and most water is absorbed.

name: Pesto pea pasta
method: Boil pasta; add peas for the final 2 minutes.
Reserve a little pasta water, then drain.
Stir pesto through pasta and peas, loosening with pasta water; add cheese or lemon if wanted.

name: Green coriander chutney
method: Wash herbs well.
Blend herbs with chilli, lemon, salt and water until smooth.
Refrigerate in a clean sealed container and use within 3 days.

name: Peanut chutney powder
method: If needed, toast peanuts in a dry pan and cool completely.
Pulse peanuts, sesame, chilli, salt and garlic until crumbly, not creamy.
Store in an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.

name: Mint yogurt dip
method: Stir yogurt until smooth.
Mix in chopped mint, lemon, cumin and salt.
Chill until serving; refrigerate leftovers promptly.

name: Quick garlic chilli oil
method: Put chilli flakes, finely minced garlic and sesame in a heatproof microwave-safe bowl.
Warm oil separately in short 20-second microwave bursts until hot, not smoking; carefully pour over chilli mixture.
Cool, refrigerate promptly and use within 4 days because it contains fresh garlic.

name: Greek-inspired salad
method: Chop cucumber and tomato.
Add feta and olives if available.
Dress with olive oil, lemon and black pepper; toss.

name: Chickpea cucumber salad
method: Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Mix chickpeas with chopped cucumber and tomato.
Add lemon, oil, cumin and salt; toss and rest 5 minutes.

name: Corn cucumber cheese salad
method: If frozen, microwave corn with a teaspoon of water for 1–2 minutes; drain and cool. Drain canned corn instead.
Mix corn with chopped cucumber.
Add cheese, lemon, pepper and yogurt if wanted; toss.

name: Peanut lime slaw

ingredients.text: 1 cup shredded cabbage or coleslaw mix

method: Put cabbage and grated carrot in a bowl.
Mix lime juice, soy sauce and honey/sugar; pour over vegetables.
Toss and top with crushed peanuts just before eating.

name: Paneer burrito bowl
method: Cube paneer and season with cumin and salt; pan-sear 4–5 minutes or microwave until hot.
Microwave rice, drained beans and corn in separate safe bowls until steaming hot.
Build a bowl with rice, beans, corn, paneer and salsa.

name: Jeera rice and paneer bowl
method: Heat butter/oil and cumin seeds for 20 seconds; add rice and peas until hot. Microwave alternative: warm rice/peas and mix with cumin powder.
Warm paneer cubes in a pan or microwave until hot.
Serve paneer over jeera rice.

name: Palak paneer rice bowl
method: Cook chopped onion in oil for 2 minutes; add garlic for 30 seconds and spinach until wilted.
Stir in milk/cream, garam masala and salt. Leave chunky or blend once slightly cooled.
Add paneer and simmer 3–4 minutes; serve over steaming-hot rice.

name: Microwave chickpea rice bowl
method: Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to a safe bowl with rice and spinach.
Cover loosely and microwave 2 minutes; stir and continue in 30-second bursts until steaming hot.
Mix yogurt with cumin, lemon and salt; spoon over the bowl.

name: Microwave mug brownie

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp neutral oil or melted butter

method: In a large microwave-safe mug, mix flour, sugar, cocoa and a pinch of salt.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth; add chocolate chips if using.
Microwave 45 seconds, then use 10-second bursts until mostly set. Rest 1 minute; mug will be hot.

name: Peanut butter chocolate mug cake
method: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder in a large microwave-safe mug.
Stir in milk and peanut butter until there are no big dry pockets.
Microwave 50 seconds, then 10-second bursts until just set. Rest 1 minute.

name: Yogurt berry crunch cup
method: Spoon yogurt into a cup or bowl.
Add berries or sliced banana and granola/crushed biscuits.
Add honey and cinnamon if wanted; assemble just before eating to keep crunch.

name: Shortcut pav bhaji
method: Pierce potato and microwave 4–6 minutes, turning halfway, until soft. Cool, peel and mash. Microwave vegetables with a splash of water until soft; mash roughly.
Cook onion in half the butter for 2 minutes; add tomato and pav bhaji masala for 3 minutes.
Add potato, vegetables, salt and a splash of water; mash and simmer 5 minutes. Toast pav in remaining butter.

name: Quick veg fried rice
method: Cook garlic in oil for 30 seconds; add vegetables until hot.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce; stir-fry until steaming hot.
Microwave option: combine in a safe bowl, cover loosely, heat in 1-minute bursts and stir between bursts until steaming hot.

name: Easy dal and rice bowl
method: Mix lentils, water, turmeric, cumin and salt in a microwave-safe bowl.
Cover loosely and microwave 1–2 minutes; stir and heat in 30-second bursts until steaming hot.
Warm rice until steaming hot, stir ghee/butter into dal and serve together.

name: Microwave masala potato chaat
method: Wash and pierce potato several times with a fork; microwave on a safe plate 4–6 minutes, turning halfway, until soft. Cool slightly.
Cut into bite-size pieces; add chaat masala, lemon and salt.
Top with yogurt and chutneys if available; mix gently.
